constraints.explanation: a bite at each edge leaves at least half the marking painted
the paint and its beads together fit inside the height range

controls.explanation: The paint itself, where it is unworn.
controls.label: Paint colour

controls.explanation: The dirt the road leaves on the paint.
controls.label: Grime colour

controls.explanation: How deep the deepest chunk missing from the marking edge is.
controls.label: Edge bites

controls.explanation: How many places along one tile the edge can be bitten; fewer means longer bites.
controls.label: Edge bite spacing

controls.explanation: How much of the paint is gone, in percent, where the wear is worst.
controls.label: Wear

controls.explanation: How many worn holes fit along one tile; more means smaller holes.
controls.label: Wear size

controls.explanation: How many patches the wear gathers into along one tile, as a tyre track is a patch.
controls.label: Wear patches

controls.explanation: How much the paint greys where it is worn thin but not yet gone, in percent.
controls.label: Thinning

controls.explanation: How many beads of the paint fit along one tile; more means finer.
controls.label: Bead size

controls.explanation: How far the beads in the paint stand above it.
controls.label: Bead relief

controls.explanation: How much the beads show as a change of tone.
controls.label: Bead tone

controls.explanation: How far the paint stands above the road it is laid on.
controls.label: Paint thickness

controls.explanation: The most the road grime darkens the paint, in percent.
controls.label: Grime

controls.explanation: How many patches of grime fit along one tile; more means smaller patches.
controls.label: Grime patches

controls.explanation: How matte the paint is, in thousandths; beads make it grittier than the road.
controls.label: Paint roughness

controls.explanation: How much grime dulls the paint further, in percent.
controls.label: Grime roughness

controls.explanation: Millimetres between the lowest and highest point the height map can hold.
controls.label: Height range

controls.explanation: How far around each point the surface is compared to find crevices.
controls.label: Occlusion radius

controls.explanation: How far below its surroundings a point must sit to be fully shadowed.
controls.label: Occlusion depth

controls.explanation: The darkest a crevice can get, in thousandths.
controls.label: Occlusion strength
